newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's president Mubarak leaves for Syria.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's president Mubarak leaves for Syria.

text.p: Egypt's President Hosni Mubarak left on Saturday for Syria, airport sources said.

Mubarak was accompanied by ministers including Foreign Minister Amr Moussa, who held talks on Friday with European Union envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos about the Syrian and Lebanese tracks of the peace process between Israel and its Arab neighbours.
Moussa had said Egypt, Syria and Saudi Arabia were coordinating on ways to boost negotiations.

Syria's Vice-President Abdel-Halim al-Khaddam and Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara toured several Arab countries, including Egypt and Saudi Arabia, over the past month to garner support for Damascus in its deadlocked talks with Israel.
Talks between Syria and Israel were halted last year while the Jewish state still had a Labour government in office.
The main stumbling block in the negotiations were the Golan Heights, which Israel captured during the 1967 Middle East war.
Negotiations have not resumed under right-wing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government. Syria insists it will resume talks if they begin where the last round left off.
